recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast typographic composition featuring two arched rows of custom blackletter-style characters that appear to be formed from wispy, iridescent smoke or vapor against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured vaporous forms against a void-like black background
Arched alignment of the top and bottom text rows creating a circular flow
White core highlights transitioning into iridescent pastel glows
coreInvariants: Iridescent chromatic aberration effect on the edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white core of the upper row of text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the upward arch of the top row, then curves down to follow the downward arch of the bottom row, creating a rhythmic, circular motion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central graphic, emphasizing the 'floating' nature of the smoke.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Iridescent pastels (Cyan, Magenta, Lime Green, Soft Blue)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white and black; low saturation in the iridescent glows to maintain a ghostly appearance.
paletteRestrictions: No hard edges in color transitions

letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes are thick and textured like pulled cotton or smoke
Horizontal connectors are thin and wispy
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated into vertical smoke trails
Internal counters are partially obscured by vapor
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: None; the illustrated type stands alone.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the basic gothic structure for warping and texturing.
Authentic historical skeleton for the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid, deep black canvas with a very subtle film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom blackletter text in a double-arched formation. Render the text using a white airbrush texture that mimics smoke, then apply a soft cyan and magenta outer glow with a slight offset to simulate iridescent chromatic aberration.

verificationChecks: Do the letters look like they are made of vapor rather than solid material?
Is the iridescent glow subtle and pastel-toned?
Is the blackletter skeleton legible despite the texture?

adjustableVariables: Length of the vertical smoke trails
mustRedesign: Any specific brand names or logos
Exact character-for-character transcription of the source text
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ghosting' effects on the edges of letters
Ensure the white core is the brightest point of the image
Verify that the text follows a symmetrical arch
Confirm the absence of any background elements other than black
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Gothic/Blackletter Typography] + [Arched Layout] + [Smoke/Vapor Texture] + [Iridescent Glow] + [Black Background] to create a dark ethereal aesthetic.
